Offline mode

Keep the mission on your phone

Once added to your Home Screen, the whole game works without ship Wi-Fi.

  1. Open this page in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button.
  3. Choose Add to Home Screen, then tap Add.
  4. Open it once before sailing. Your progress stays on this device.

Play it your way

No drinking required

  • Water, soft drinks and alcohol-free choices count at every stop.
  • Never rush on stairs or decks. Use the lifts if anyone feels unsteady.
  • Follow venue opening times, age rules and crew instructions.
  • The Exchange is adults-only; some experiences are chargeable and need booking.
  • Anyone can skip a challenge or finish the game at any time.
